# Global chip demand spikes, supply risk stays elevated  
**Bottom line:** Prices stay high and supply remains tight; lock in pricing only where lead times are short.

## What changed
- Market‑wide supply risk holds at 73 (Neutral change) and price trend at 87.9, both unchanged from last week [source 1].  
- Producer price index surged +32.6 % annualized over the last three months, pushing both supply tightness and price pressure [1].  
- Global chip sales jumped +148.3 % YoY in September, reinforcing demand‑driven price rises [2].  
- TSMC revenue growth (+56 % YoY) signals higher foundry loading, tightening supply further [3].  
- Korea’s chip‑led exports doubled YoY in early November, a leading indicator of continued demand pressure [4].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks, stock 27,081 units, no on‑order quantity disclosed.  
- Price $5.56 for qty 1, $2.51 for 1 k units.  
- Origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk 53.6 (Neutral) and price trend 72.0 (Rising).  
- Call: **Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)** – 63 % chance prices rise in 3 months, but 14‑week lead and 17.6 weeks of channel stock keep supply adequate [source featured_part].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic (71.9, –0.1) supply | 84.9 price | High confidence  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) (70.1, 0) supply | 76.9 price | High confidence  
- Analog & power (69.3, 0) supply | 82.6 price | High confidence  
- Microcontrollers (68.2, 0) supply | 82.1 price | High confidence  
- Power discretes (67.3, 0) supply | 85.4 price | High confidence  

## Your BOM watchlist
- **SN65HVD230DR** – lead time 26 weeks vs ~12 week norm, supply risk 82.4.  
- **LM358DR** – same 26‑week lead, supply risk 82.2.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – 26‑week lead, supply risk 81.8.  
- **TLV9002IDR** – 26‑week lead, supply risk 81.7.  
- **ADS1115IDGSR** – 26‑week lead, supply risk 81.5.  

## Outlook
- Chip prices in the next 3 months: 70.5 % chance of rise, expected +2.53 % (80 % range ‑9.18 % to +14.25 %); model‑based edge tested [forecast 1].  
- Chip prices in the next 6 months: 55.6 % chance of rise, expected +5.07 % (‑10.16 % to +20.3 %); trend‑following baseline [forecast 2].  
- Fab utilization (supply) next 3 months: 62.5 % chance of tightening, expected +1.82 pts (‑1.71 to +5.36 pts) [forecast 3].  
- Fab utilization next 6 months: 59.7 % chance of tightening, expected +3.64 pts (‑2.16 to +9.45 pts) [forecast 4].  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock pricing now** for parts with short lead times and neutral supply risk (e.g., IPB017N10N5ATMA1) to avoid the 63 % price‑rise probability.  
2. **Push for volume discounts** on high‑risk analog parts with 26‑week leads; suppliers may concede price to secure long‑term demand.  
3. **Ask for supply‑chain visibility** (on‑order quantities, next‑arrival dates) on the watchlist items to gauge whether a “buy ahead” strategy is warranted before lead times extend further.
